issues.description: Inconsistent getter name for StockIngredient.name across artifacts. The template repository defines the getter as getIngredientName() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java) and the template's Stock.findStockIngredient(...) calls x.getIngredientName(). The solution repository, however, defines the getter as getName() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java) and its Stock.findStockIngredient(...) calls x.getName(). The problem statement asks students to "add getters for all the private fields" but does not prescribe the exact getter naming convention. This naming mismatch creates an inconsistent public API between the template and the reference solution and can confuse students about which getter name to implement or which name tests expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Standardize the getter name across template, solution, and documentation. Preferred action: use the conventional getName() for the StockIngredient.name field. Update the template's StockIngredient to provide public String getName() (and optionally keep getIngredientName() as a delegating alias for backwards compatibility), and update all call sites in Stock.findStockIngredient(...) to use getName(). Also update the problem statement to explicitly state the expected getter naming convention (get<FieldName>()). If keeping both names, document that an alias may exist so students are not confused.
